findings.disposition: Resolved in corrected MP4 74dbdaec8c5bf8d64275ea0a76951ef9b83d1f7cd4739ce67c4a1236b6459657: direct 1920x1080 inspection at 9 seconds and the revised contact sheet confirm the added caption/black plate are absent and the mine label/health bar are visible. title_card_review.evidence_source: Initial MP4 direct frame at 42.5/44.9 seconds; both contact-sheet versions at 42.5/44 seconds. Producer's caption_correction.json records the title-card cut unchanged.

limitations: No full continuous playback or listening was performed; motion smoothness, every transition, audio quality and audiovisual synchronization are not independently certified.
No human viewer panel, unfamiliar-player test, Steam transcode, upload, live store page or client playback was inspected.
Native HUD/world-label crowding prevents a blanket claim that all on-screen text is unobscured. The separate 9-second promotional-caption obstruction was confirmed fixed in the corrected MP4.
Source-build and unchanged-viewport provenance come from source_capture_summary.json and screenshot_qa.json; this review did not rerun the game capture.
The annotated contact sheet has only 480x270 pixels per video sample; fine readability conclusions rely on the original screenshots and the listed 1920x1080 extracted frames.

overall.conclusion: The corrected 9-second sample exposes the gold-mine label/health bar after removal of the added caption. The inspected media convey RTS construction, unit command and land/water combat, with stylized blood present in the recorded samples. The final illustrated card uses the approved woman-led artwork. Native UI crowding remains documented. No full continuous playback or listening was performed.
